subject: Shinydashboard: Why is there a limitation on the colors (validColors) ?

messages.author: 605c14114b1f1179
messages.subject: Shinydashboard: Why is there a limitation on the colors (validColors) ?
parts:
Why is there a limitation on the colors that infoBox can have (based on validColors); 

Can we style of infobox (change the background color to an arbitrary one), based on the value it displays? (That will require the renderInfoBox to accept/pass a the style argument)

Thanks in advance of your insight/feedback/help

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Shinydashboard: Why is there a limitation on the colors (validColors) ?
parts:
The available colors are determined by Bootstrap and AdminLTE, which shinydashboard builds on.

You can make the entire infoBox dynamic (including the color) by using infoBoxOutput() on the UI side, and renderInfoBox() on the server side.

-Winston
